title: Trust, but Verify: Knowledge Agents for Finance Workflows - Mike Conover
talk_summary: Mike Conover describes Brightwave's finance research agent: decompose research into retrieval, distillation, enrichment, synthesis, and human steering with audit trails. He argues for simple composable tools, per-node model choice, secondary verification calls, and granular synthesis instructions rather than anthropomorphic agent roles.

takeaways.what_they_do: After a model extracts or asserts a finding, run a fresh call asking whether the claim is factually entailed by the source, instead of asking the same context to self-check.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's actually more powerful to do it as a secondary call because the model is kind of primed to be credulous

takeaways.what_they_do: Split large synthesis tasks into named subthemes with specific instructions and limits, because models compress large inputs into relatively short outputs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you can be more granular and more specific um you can get higher quality higher Fidelity more information dense outputs
takeaways.numbers: claims o1 has 100k output context but outputs ~2-3k tokens

takeaways.technique: Simple composable tools over role agents
takeaways.what_they_do: Use narrow single-purpose tools/nodes that compose through a universal interface, rather than anthropomorphized agents like 'portfolio manager agent' or 'fact checker'.
takeaways.evidence_quote: just simple tools that do one thing and that work together well

takeaways.what_they_do: Choose the model/tool for each node in the compute graph based on the price-performance frontier rather than using one model everywhere.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you have to select then which tool which system which model am I going to use for each node in the compute graph

takeaways.what_they_do: Attach evidentiary passages and contextual metadata to each finding so a human can inspect why it matters and audit the trail.
takeaways.evidence_quote: with um evidentiary um passages a metadata that contextualizes why do I care about this

takeaways.what_they_do: Avoid long silent agent runs; optimize time-to-value and surface intermediate notes so users can steer before the final output.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if it's a 8 Minute feedback loop it's a 20-minute feedback loop goodness you're not going to do many of those
